notes.title: Thieves Of Dingirra crowdfunding!
notes.notes:
Greetings all,
We’re thrilled to unveil the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/thieves-of-dingirra?ref=3sbfmz]crowdfunding campaign[/url] for our upcoming fantasy game, "Thieves of Dingirra." This title blends town management, RPG mechanics, and, of course, visual novel elements with romance.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/ecb59186b4f5d6ee76f11feb716e982bf6f4c4f6.jpg[/img]
The core experience is designed to be approachable and casual, ensuring it’s not overwhelming, while still delivering strong replay value through numerous random events. RPG battles are limited to a set number, eliminating the need for grinding. 
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/4fa8ac2a0a0ada528139401e812cad46b23d61fd.jpg[/img]

You’ll still have the freedom to equip your party, choose skills, and assign attributes during level-ups, but the focus remains on a curated sequence of missions—no endless farming required.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/19621ae33bc1d3317da5860ed2793ee5f37b18bd.jpg[/img]
These missions unfold in a rogue-like fashion, featuring a map of various locations within a target building. Each spot presents unique possibilities: a skirmish, a trap, a hidden treasure, a captive to free, and more. Strategic party and inventory management will be key—pack too many healing potions, and you’ll leave less room for stolen loot.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/b24cddcced84c4349f1165bfdd28a97400298c31.jpg[/img]
On the romance front, the game offers six love interests for your male or female protagonist to pursue with two bisexual furry characters.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/e62d66c761f5b322365bced5ddbc4f7c146e49ff.jpg[/img]
For a deeper dive, visit our Kickstarter page:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/thieves-of-dingirra?ref=3sbfmz]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/thieves-of-dingirra[/url]

Or add the game to your Steam wishlist here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/617990/Thieves_Of_Dingirra/

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: New crowdfunding campaign for yuri visual novel: Christine's Care
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
we just launched a new Kickstarter campaign for a new slice of life yuri visual novel called Christine's Care:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/christine-0?ref=2tusob][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/f9127f55bb3e2f37d8f888f790c8f12eb81f6b78.jpg[/img][/url]

Check the campaign page here: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/christine-0?ref=2tusob]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/christine-0[/url]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/christine-0?ref=2tusob][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/44d6e77f768ef91a16e87207df96a83e0a85935c.jpg[/img][/url]
Set in early 2000s Canada, this yuri visual novel follows Christine, a nurse reeling from a recent breakup with her boyfriend. Still nursing emotional wounds, Christine is assigned to care for Hannah, a patient just a few months older than herself who became paralyzed from the waist down after a car accident.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/christine-0?ref=2tusob][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/49a6a3c9881a5e1a259b48f79534948807b0c052.jpg[/img][/url]
Although Hannah has been labeled as a difficult and "problematic" patient, Christine is immediately captivated by her personality. Beneath her sharp edges, Christine finds Hannah's outlook on life refreshingly unique, marked by wit and surprising depth. Despite frequent bouts of depression and anger caused by her condition, Hannah's sense of humor helps her navigate the darkest moments. She's also exceptionally talented, with a knack for playing the guitar and a gift for singing that reveals a quieter, more soulful side.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/christine-0?ref=2tusob][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/c44551c833a88e88d60901cca0445f9ccb957316.jpg[/img][/url]
As Christine spends more time caring for Hannah, she begins to see past her own heartache. The bond between them deepens, and Christine finds herself slowly falling in love with Hannah, awakening feelings she had never explored before—her attraction to another woman, and a new understanding of her own sexuality.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/winterwolves/christine-0?ref=2tusob][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/2717761/9021bdaeaffc3701d37ec3b6a1aa827333e14d0c.jpg[/img][/url]
At the same time, Christine crosses paths with an intriguing couple, Marlon and Liz. Marlon, a muscular Latina bodybuilder, exudes strength and confidence, while Liz, her slender Asian partner, contrasts with a quieter, more delicate presence. The couple shares a dominant-submissive dynamic, with Marlon firmly in control.

One evening, Marlon, sensing Christine’s curiosity, invites her to step into a more dominant role with Liz. Hesitant at first, Christine agrees, and to her surprise, she finds herself deeply enjoying the experience—perhaps even more than she anticipated. In the days that follow, Liz begins openly flirting with Christine, subtly suggesting that she might be interested in a new dominant figure. The offer is tempting, but Christine knows that Marlon is not someone to cross lightly.

As Christine navigates these new desires, the tension between her feelings for Hannah and her growing fascination with Marlon and Liz threatens to pull her in conflicting directions, forcing her to confront parts of herself she had never acknowledged.
